name: Spanish-Style Shakshuka
method: Heat the oil in a small frying pan over a medium heat, add the chopped chorizo and fry gently for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and pepper and fry for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in most of the paprika, the cumin and the tomato puree, fry for a minute, then add a splash of water.
Pour in the tomatoes, bring to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until reduced slightly, then season.
Make two wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook gently for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Spoon over the yoghurt, finish with a pinch of paprika and serve with two slices of toasted bread.
